description: Create an Airflow 2.x DAG for fintech_app's regulatory reporting pipeline with task-level SLAs and a DAG-level sla_miss_callback. Tasks: extract_trades (SLA 30 min), enrich_counterparties (SLA 1 h), build_report (SLA 1 h 30 min), submit_report (SLA 2 h); SLAs are measured from the scheduled run time. The sla_miss_callback must post to Slack with the list of missed tasks and blocking tasks, and page on-call only if 'submit_report' is among the misses. The DAG runs on weekdays at 18:00 Europe/London, and the regulatory deadline is 21:00 local time.
edge_cases: Airflow SLAs are measured relative to the end of the data interval (the scheduled run time), not the task start time; they are cumulative deadlines, not durations
SLA misses are not evaluated for manually triggered runs; a separate deadline check task is needed for those
sla_miss_callback has a different signature from on_failure_callback and receives no context dict
An SLA miss does not stop or fail the task; execution_timeout is needed to bound runtime
Trades enriched via LEFT JOIN: missing counterparty must block submission rather than send blank LEI fields
common_failure_modes: FM6: Reusing an on_failure_callback function as sla_miss_callback raises a TypeError inside the scheduler and no alert is sent
FM6: Treating sla as per-task duration, so cumulative delay goes undetected
FM7: Report submitted with NULL counterparty identifiers
